# Get help with nipa

| You have | Go to |
| --- | --- |
| An error from nipa | [Troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md), then `nipa doctor` |
| A question about a command | [CLI reference](../docs/cli-reference.md), or `nipa <command> --help` |
| A bug in nipa | [A bug report](https://github.com/PunGrumpy/nipa/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| A command or option you want | [A feature request](https://github.com/PunGrumpy/nipa/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| A security problem | The [security policy](SECURITY.md) |
| A problem with your Nipa Cloud account or projects | [Nipa Cloud](https://nipa.cloud) |
